summary: Re-verified Employee role permissions enforcement after cleanup of residual database overrides. The reported issue from iteration_5 (Employee GET /api/loans returned 200 instead of 403) has been confirmed FIXED. Root cause was leftover per-tenant role override in db.role_permissions that granted loans.read to Employee role during previous testing. After deletion of that override, Employee role correctly falls back to static defaults which do NOT include loans.read or finance.read. All enforcement tests passed.
passed_tests: Employee role has clean defaults (no loans.read or finance.read)
Employee role is NOT customized (no per-tenant overrides in db.role_permissions)
Employee has expected permissions: holidays.read, attendance.read, attendance.create, expenses.read, expenses.create
Employee GET /api/loans -> 403 (correctly denied - CRITICAL FIX VERIFIED)
Employee GET /api/attendance/records -> 200 (returns only own records, not all employees)
Admin GET /api/loans -> 200 (regression check: Admin still has access)
